```sql
SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    u.Location
FROM main.users u
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        u2.Id,
        COUNT(*) as accepted_count
    FROM main.posts p_answer
    INNER JOIN main.posts p_question ON p_answer.Id = p_question.AcceptedAnswerId
    INNER JOIN main.users u2 ON p_answer.OwnerUserId = u2.Id
    WHERE p_answer.PostTypeId = 2
        AND p_question.PostTypeId = 1
        AND p_question.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
        AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p_answer.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
        AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p_question.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
    GROUP BY u2.Id
    ORDER BY accepted_count DESC
    LIMIT 10
) top_users ON u.Id = top_users.Id
ORDER BY top_users.accepted_count DESC
```
